sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Krishan Singh Dadwal, Advocate
 for the petitioner.

The instant petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C., has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in FIR No.01, dated 14.02.2022, under Sections 420 and 120-B of IPC, 1860, registered at Police Station NRI, District Hoshiarpur (Annexure P-5).
This Court vide order dated 10.03.2022, while issuing notice of motion, granted the concession of interim bail to the petitioner, subject to his joining the investigation.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in pursuance to the order dated 10.03.2022 the petitioner has joined the investigation.
Learned State counsel does not controvert the said fact and further submits that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required.
In view of the above, the order dated 10.03.2022 is made absolute.
